code-runner.executorMap.cpp: cd $dir && mkdir -p "$workspaceRoot/.build" && /usr/bin/clang++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -g $fullFileName -o "$workspaceRoot/.build/run-cpp" && if [ -f "$fileNameWithoutExt.in" ]; then "$workspaceRoot/.build/run-cpp" < "$fileNameWithoutExt.in" > "$fileNameWithoutExt.actual" && cat "$fileNameWithoutExt.actual" && if [ -f "$fileNameWithoutExt.out" ]; then diff -w "$fileNameWithoutExt.out" "$fileNameWithoutExt.actual" && echo PASS; fi; else "$workspaceRoot/.build/run-cpp"; fi
